Manga 'Gabriel DropOut' Concludes Serialization
The official X account for author Ukami announced on Sunday that the Gabriel DropOut manga will end in the October issue of Comic Dengeki Daioh "g" magazine, marking the end of the manga's nearly 13-year run. Ukami began serializing the supernatural comedy manga in Comic Dengeki Daioh "g" magazine in December 2013. Kadokawa published the 16th volume in September 2025. Webtoon 'Villains Are Destined to Die' Gets TV Anime
Publishing company Kakao Piccoma announced a television anime adaptation of Gyeoeul Gwon's Villains Are Destined to Die webtoon on Sunday, revealing a visual commemorating the conclusion of the main story (pictured above). Gwon penned the original web novel on the KakaoPage website from March 2019 to August 2020. D&C Media published the series in four volumes, as well as the side story the following month.
